scope: Actual saved Game0 turn6 selected BT22-022 evolution and its immediate Tamer-play/derived effects

rules_assessment.evolution: LEGAL printed Blue2 fromLv3; pay2 ->memory6, place BT22-022 above source stack keeping entity/orientation, draw1 before When Digivolving processing
rules_assessment.tamer_count_condition: At processing B has exactly one own battle Tamer EX13-069#4; 1-or-fewer condition is met. A Tamers are excluded.
rules_assessment.text_qualification: Both Rinas contain Veedramon in printed main text and qualify per BT22-022 Q4875 / EX13-022 Q7264. Newly drawn EX13-069#3 is eligible.
rules_assessment.optional_choice: Decline remains explicit None; free play costs0. BT22-022 When Digivolving has no Once Per Turn clause.
rules_assessment.same_target_for_both_aero_observers: LEGAL; each distinct effect requires one currently eligible target, with no different-target condition

expiration.scope: Both B Rina Blocker/Evade grants and B Aero cannot_suspend restrictions last through A next turn7, expiring at its completed end boundary.

egg_inherited_trigger.text: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When any of your blue Tamers are played, this Digimon with [Veedramon] in its name may unsuspend.
egg_inherited_trigger.trigger_condition: B blue Tamer played during B turn true for either eligible Rina
egg_inherited_trigger.actual_result_of_unsuspend_processing: No orientation change / no actual unsuspend under CR1-3-3; no derived EX1-013 or Rina unsuspend reaction. Optional processing still must be explicitly represented or precisely halted.

rules_assessment.group_order: All are B effects at the same timing; B explicitly chooses activation order (CR15-4-3-5-1). Derived groups complete before earlier pending effects.
no_other_actual_triggers: A Aero does not trigger on B Tamer: its your refers to A.
B BT11-023 blue-Tamer memory effect is inherited, so inactive while BT11-023 is its own top.
Neither digivolution nor unsuspended-to-unsuspended processing is an actual unsuspend.
Playing EX13-069 produces no self On Play effect.

findings.description: Supporting BT22-022 free Tamer only through existing two-Aero observer logic misses the exposed egg inherited trigger in this exact stack. Existing guard correctly halts an unimplemented live observer; do not bypass or silently omit it.
findings.status: Reported immediately to parent implementer; source remains read-only for this reviewer.

verification.prefix_revalidation: PASS exact physical state and RNG before selected evolution
verification.note: This artifact does not claim the unsupported evolution or subsequent free-play branch has been resolved.
